name: jellyfin-plugin-prism
description: Prism — True-black OLED UI, ClearLogo spotlights, 3-day rotating discovery & holiday picks, thematic collections, native watchlist, library infinite scroll, and LG WebOS 60fps guardrails for Jellyfin 12.4+.

scripts.build:plugin: npm run build && dotnet build plugin/Jellyfin.Plugin.Prism/Jellyfin.Plugin.Prism.csproj -c Release
